name: Introduction to Networking
description: Covers fundamental networking concepts including OSI model, TCP/IP protocols, network topologies, IP addressing, subnetting, and basic network configuration. Students learn to set up and troubleshoot small networks.

name: Systems Software and Computing Concepts
description: Introduces operating systems concepts including process management, memory management, file systems, and concurrency. Covers computer architecture, CPU organisation, and system-level programming concepts.

name: Introduction to Databases
description: Covers relational database design, entity-relationship modelling, normalisation, and SQL querying. Students learn to design and implement relational databases using database management systems.

name: Digital Thinking and Innovation
description: Introduces design thinking, creative problem solving, and innovation frameworks in a digital context. Students develop critical thinking, ideation, and prototyping skills for technology-driven solutions.

name: Python Programming
description: Introduces programming using Python. Topics include variables, control structures, functions, lists, dictionaries, file handling, and basic object-oriented programming. Emphasis on problem solving and algorithmic thinking.

name: Systems Analysis and Design
description: Covers the software development lifecycle, requirements gathering, use case modelling, data flow diagrams, and system design techniques. Students learn to analyse business requirements and produce system specifications.

name: Integrated Computer Systems
description: Explores the integration of hardware and software components in computer systems. Topics include computer architecture, assembly language basics, input/output systems, and embedded computing concepts.

name: Fundamental of Entrepreneurship
description: Introduces entrepreneurial thinking, business model development, startup ecosystems, and innovation management. Students develop communication, teamwork, and business planning skills.

name: Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming
description: Covers object-oriented programming principles including classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, and abstraction. Students implement OOP solutions using Java or a similar language.

name: Mathematical Concepts for Computing
description: Covers discrete mathematics, logic, sets, functions, graph theory, probability, and combinatorics as applied to computing. Builds mathematical foundations for algorithm analysis and software engineering.

name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: Introduces AI concepts including search algorithms, knowledge representation, machine learning basics, and intelligent agents. Students explore how AI techniques are applied to real-world problems.

name: Fundamentals of Web Design and Development
description: Covers HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals for building responsive web pages. Students learn web design principles, accessibility, and basic front-end development techniques.

name: Innovation Process
description: Examines structured approaches to innovation including lean startup, agile methodologies, and design sprints. Students apply innovation frameworks to develop and validate technology product ideas.

name: Research Methods for Computing and Technology
description: Covers quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, literature review techniques, research design, data collection, and academic writing. Students develop skills to conduct and report computing research.

name: Programming for Data Analysis
description: Introduces data analysis using Python libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib. Topics include data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis, and data visualisation.

name: System Development Methods
description: Covers software development methodologies including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and DevOps. Students learn sprint planning, backlog management, continuous integration, and software project management practices.

name: Object Oriented Development with Java
description: Advanced Java programming covering design patterns, collections framework, exception handling, multithreading, file I/O, and building enterprise-grade object-oriented applications.

name: Requirements Engineering
description: Covers techniques for eliciting, analysing, specifying, and validating software requirements. Topics include functional and non-functional requirements, use cases, user stories, and requirements traceability.

name: Enterprise Systems
description: Examines enterprise application architecture, ERP systems, middleware, and integration patterns. Students learn to design and evaluate large-scale enterprise software solutions.

name: Data Structures
description: Covers fundamental data structures including arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, and hash tables. Emphasis on algorithm complexity analysis, sorting, and searching techniques.

name: Software Testing
description: Covers software testing strategies including unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and acceptance testing. Topics include test-driven development, test case design, automated testing, and quality assurance.

name: Software Architecture
description: Introduces architectural styles and patterns including MVC, microservices, layered architecture, and event-driven systems. Students learn to design scalable, maintainable software architectures.

name: Design Methods
description: Covers UML modelling, design patterns such as Singleton, Factory, and Observer, and software design principles including SOLID. Students apply design techniques to produce robust software designs.

name: Concurrent Programming
description: Covers multithreading, synchronisation, parallel computing, deadlock prevention, and concurrent data structures. Students implement concurrent programs and analyse race conditions and thread safety.

name: Further Web Design and Development
description: Advanced web development covering React, REST APIs, authentication, state management, and full-stack application development. Students build and deploy dynamic web applications.

name: Mobile App Engineering
description: Covers mobile application development for Android or iOS platforms. Topics include UI design, lifecycle management, data persistence, APIs, and publishing mobile applications.

name: Venture Building
description: Focuses on building technology ventures including business model canvas, market validation, pitch development, and startup financing. Students develop entrepreneurial and leadership skills.

name: Development and Operations
description: Covers DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, containerisation with Docker, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and cloud deployment. Students implement automated software delivery pipelines.

name: Investigations in Software Engineering
description: A research-based module where students investigate current topics and challenges in software engineering through literature review, experimentation, and critical analysis.

name: Project Management
description: Covers software project planning, estimation, scheduling, risk management, and team leadership. Students apply project management tools and techniques including Gantt charts, earned value analysis, and agile planning.

name: Design Patterns
description: Advanced coverage of Gang of Four design patterns, architectural patterns, and anti-patterns. Students apply creational, structural, and behavioural patterns to solve complex software design problems.

name: Software Quality Engineering
description: Covers software quality metrics, static analysis, code reviews, test automation frameworks, performance testing, and continuous quality improvement practices in software development.

name: User Experience
description: Covers UX research methods, usability testing, wireframing, prototyping, and interaction design. Students apply human-centred design principles to evaluate and improve software interfaces.

name: Project in Software Engineering
description: Final year project requiring students to design, develop, and evaluate a software engineering solution for a real-world problem. Demonstrates integration of technical, analytical, and project management skills.

name: Designing and Developing Applications on Cloud
description: Covers cloud application development using platforms such as AWS or Azure. Topics include serverless computing, cloud-native architecture, microservices deployment, and cloud security.

name: Distributed Computer Systems
description: Covers distributed system concepts including consistency, fault tolerance, CAP theorem, distributed databases, message queues, and designing distributed applications.

name: Enterprise Programming for Distributed Applications
description: Covers enterprise Java frameworks such as Jakarta EE, RESTful web services, microservices, and distributed application design patterns for large-scale systems.

name: Blockchain Development
description: Introduces blockchain technology, smart contracts, decentralised applications, and consensus mechanisms. Students build and deploy blockchain-based solutions.

name: Advanced Database Systems
description: Covers advanced database topics including query optimisation, transaction management, distributed databases, NoSQL systems, and big data storage solutions.

name: Optimisation and Deep Learning
description: Covers mathematical optimisation techniques and deep learning architectures including neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs, and RNNs. Students implement and train deep learning models.
